scope: Standard full-game markets only. NHL rules come from config/nhl_settlement.json. A pair is locked only when both books have a profile on file for the market group and the profiles match; anything else is listed under Check before betting. Confirm jurisdiction, market header and void exceptions before every bet.
assumed_note: Assumed industry-standard rules, set 2026-10-22 when the multi-sport arbitrage scan launched, following the NHL treatment (owner decision 2026-10-06). Not yet checked against each book's published rules. Remove a book or market group here to send its pairs to Check before betting; replace each assumption with a source once its rules are read.

kinds.licensed: Licensed by US state regulators where it operates.
kinds.offshore: Not licensed by any US state. Legal, payout and account risks are yours.
kinds.sweepstakes: A sweepstakes or social sportsbook, not a state-licensed sportsbook.

nba_full_game_ot.label: Includes overtime
nba_full_game_ot.description: Moneylines, spreads and totals are graded on the final score including overtime.

nba_player_ot_participation.label: Overtime counts; void if the player doesn't play
nba_player_ot_participation.description: Player props count the whole game including overtime. A player who does not play is void, not a loss.

pending.fanatics: Not yet on file, as for NHL; its pairs go to Check before betting.

nfl_full_game_ot_tie_push.label: Includes overtime; a tied moneyline is refunded
nfl_full_game_ot_tie_push.description: Moneylines, spreads and totals are graded on the final score including overtime. A two-way moneyline on a game that ends tied is a push.

nfl_player_ot_participation.label: Overtime counts; void if the player doesn't play
nfl_player_ot_participation.description: Player props count the whole game including overtime. A player who does not play is void, not a loss.

pending.fanatics: Not yet on file, as for NHL; its pairs go to Check before betting.

mlb_game_action.label: Action; official after 5 innings
mlb_game_action.description: Moneylines stand whoever pitches and are official after five innings (4½ if the home team leads). Run lines and totals need nine innings (8½ if the home team leads).

pending.batter and pitcher props: Books differ on whether a batter must start or only bat once, and on listed-pitcher voids. No player profile is on file, so every MLB prop pair goes to Check before betting.
pending.offshore game lines: Offshore books may default to listed pitchers, which voids one side if a starter changes. Not on file.
